tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search published PM Wisdom projects by name, description or tag. An empty query browses the directory. Results are ordered by name and slug.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieve a published project by its exact slug, including its description and public links.

tools.name: list_project_categories
tools.description: List categories and their published project counts. Use the exact category value with search_projects.
